scope: 25 isolated transparent symbols, exact-name outlined wordmarks and self-contained logo compositions. This is branding asset production, not app completion or native-device acceptance.

himayah.name: Himayah AI
himayah.brief: One deep-indigo protective shield enclosing a warm ivory contract page. Two simple recessed clause lines appear on the page; a small coral magnifying ring is integrated with the lower-right page edge, clearly inspecting a clause. Shield and contract must be one bold, compact silhouette. Smoked indigo #0B192C, titanium #C5C9D0, ivory #F4E7D5, coral #E7655A. This is privacy-contract protection and source-linked review. No government emblems, approval check, keyhole or unrelated location marker.
